'''Włodzimierz Stanisław Korohoda''' (1 January 1937 – 24 April 2026) was a Polish [[Cell biology|cell biologist]] and swimmer.

== Life and career ==
The son of {{ill|Jerzy Korohoda|pl|Jerzy Korohoda}}, father of {{ill|Jacek Korohoda|pl|Jacek Korohoda}}. He attended the [[Bartłomiej Nowodoworski 1st Secondary School in Kraków|Bartłomiej Nowodoworski High School in Kraków]].

From 1948, he competed in swimming in the [[KS Cracovia|Cracovia Sports Club]].<ref name="muzeumazs">{{citeweb| url = https://muzeum.azs.pl/post/attachments/40746-20190916100523982krakw_biogramy_c_1.pdf| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20260430155916/https://muzeum.azs.pl/post/attachments/40746-20190916100523982krakw_biogramy_c_1.pdf| archive-date = 2026-04-30| title = Biogramy| publisher = muzeum.azs.pl}}</ref> From 1951, he represented Kraków, simultaneously holding the Polish junior and youth champion and record in all [[breaststroke]] distances.<ref name="muzeumazs" />

Korohoda graduated in biology from the [[Jagiellonian University]] in 1959.<ref name="ludzienauki">{{citeweb| url = https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=59117&_k=bbr2pu| title = Prof. dr hab. Włodzimierz Stanisław Korohoda| publisher = archiwum.nauka-polska.pl| accessdate = 2026-04-30}}</ref><ref name="odnowieniedoktoratu">{{citeweb| url = https://humboldt.org.pl/blog/odnowienie-doktoratu-profesora-wlodzimierza-korohody| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20260313204749/https://humboldt.org.pl/blog/odnowienie-doktoratu-profesora-wlodzimierza-korohody| title = Odnowienie doktoratu Profesora Włodzimierza Korohody| archive-date = 2026-03-13| publisher = humboldt.org.pl}}</ref> In 1957 he started working at the Department of Plant Physiology headed by {{ill|Jan Zurzycki|pl|Jan Zurzycki}}.<ref name="zm" /> He obtained [[doctorate]] in 1963.<ref name="zm" /><ref name="odnowieniedoktoratu" /> In 1965 he received a scholarship from The British Council of The [[Institute of Cancer Research|Chester Beatty Royal Institute of Cancer Research in London]].<ref name="zm" /> He obtained [[habilitation]] in 1971.<ref name="zm" /><ref name="odnowieniedoktoratu" /> In 1972 he obtained a scholarship at the Institute of Cytology and Micromorphology at the [[University of Bonn]] under the supervision of W. Stockem.<ref name="odnowieniedoktoratu" />

From 1979 he was head of the Department of Cell Biology at the Institute of Molecular Biology of the Jagiellonian University; from 1981 to 1984 as its director.<ref name="pwn">{{citeweb| url = https://encyklopedia.pwn.pl/haslo/%3B3925863| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20241215113954/https://encyklopedia.pwn.pl/haslo/;3925863| archive-date = 2024-12-15| title = Korohoda Włodzimierz Stanisław| publisher = encyklopedia.pwn.pl}}</ref> He researched on the role of the cell surface complex and the cytoplasmic cytoskeleton in the regulation of cell movement, growth and differentiation.<ref name="odnowieniedoktoratu" /><ref name="pwn" /> He co-authored more than 120 research papers in peer-reviewed journals.<ref>{{citeweb| url = https://zbk.wbbib.uj.edu.pl/zespol/pracownicy/wlodzimierz-korohoda| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20260424171340/https://zbk.wbbib.uj.edu.pl/zespol/pracownicy/wlodzimierz-korohoda| archive-date = 2026-04-24| publisher = zbk.wbbib.uj.edu.pl| title = Włodzimierz Korohoda}}</ref> He supervised twenty one doctoral dissertations.<ref name="zm" /><ref name="ludzienauki" /> In 1991 he was elected a member of the [[Polish Academy of Arts and Sciences]].<ref name="pwn" /><ref name="odnowieniedoktoratu" /><ref name="zm" />

Korohoda died on 24 April 2026, at the age of 89.<ref name="zm">{{citeweb|title= Żegnamy Profesora Korohodę |accessdate= 2026-04-30|publisher= wbbib.uj.edu.pl |url = https://wbbib.uj.edu.pl/wydzial/aktualnosci/-/journal_content/56_INSTANCE_oYhIKDBXnbw9/41648/160825198 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20260424170654/https://wbbib.uj.edu.pl/wydzial/aktualnosci/-/journal_content/56_INSTANCE_oYhIKDBXnbw9/41648/160825198 |archive-date= 2026-04-24}}</ref>
